title: Trademarks for Goods and Services (Fees) Regulation Order No. 15 of 2012
text:
REPUBLIC OF VANUATU
TRADEMARKS ACT NO.1 OF 2003
Trademarks For Goods and Services (Fees) Regulation
Order No. 15 Of 2012
In exercise of the powers conferred on me by subsection 105(1) of the Trademarks
Act No. 1 of 2003, I, the Honourable VANUAROROA HAM LINI, Minister of
Trade, Tourism and Industry make the following Order.
1 Prescribed Fees
The fees prescribed in column 3 of the Schedule are payable in relation to matters
set out in column 2.
2 Commencement
This Order is taken to have commenced on 1 December 201 1.
